# Minny Agents

> AI agents for Twin Cities businesses. Based in Minneapolis, MN.

## What this site is

Minny Agents is an independent engineering practice founded by Connor Barrett. We build AI agents that answer missed calls, follow up, and keep the books moving for restaurants, shops, home-service businesses, and clinics.

We do not publish prices, client names, testimonials, or metrics. We build one custom system at a time. You approve anything that talks to customers or touches money. We do not make clinical decisions.

- Full text for answer engines: https://minnyagents.com/llms-full.txt

## Area served

Minneapolis, Saint Paul, and the Twin Cities, plus businesses across the United States.
